testCase:
D-13: Flight search: calendar with prices, passengers, results
Goal: Book the cheapest nonstop round trip from Boston (BOS) to Portland, Maine (PWM), leaving 8 January 2027 and returning 15 January 2027, for 2 adults, 1 child and 1 infant in Premium economy.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/d-13/
STEP 2: Make sure "Round trip" is selected
STEP 3: Fill "From" with "Boston" and choose "Boston, Massachusetts (BOS)"
STEP 4: Fill "To" with "Portland" and choose "Portland, Maine (PWM)"
STEP 5: Choose departure "8 January 2027" and return "15 January 2027"
STEP 6: Set passengers to 2 adults, 1 child and 1 infant
STEP 7: Select "Premium economy" in "Cabin class"
STEP 8: Click "Search"
STEP 9: Keep only nonstop flights, sort by "Cheapest" and click "Select" on the first flight
STEP 10: Verify "Booked NB 3318 BOS to PWM, 8 January 2027 – 15 January 2027, 2 adults, 1 child, 1 infant, Premium economy, total $1,254" is visible

steps.note: Choose the exact Boston airport suggestion.
Choose Portland, Maine rather than another Portland.
Set and confirm the requested cabin.
Enable and confirm the nonstop filter.
Request cheapest-first sorting; this action does not assert the resulting order.
Select the flight identified by the expected confirmation, without claiming it is the first result.

args.text: Booked NB 3318 BOS to PWM, 8 January 2027 – 15 January 2027, 2 adults, 1 child, 1 infant, Premium economy, total $1,254

steps.note: Verify the exact flight, itinerary, passenger mix, cabin, and total in the booking confirmation.

reasoning: This plan checks the requested itinerary, passenger mix, cabin, and exact booking confirmation. It targets NB 3318 using the flight identifier supplied in the expected confirmation, but the catalog cannot establish that this flight is the first result after sorting by cheapest.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Select and verify the first flight in the cheapest-sorted nonstop results: the catalog has no positional targeting or result-order assertion, so targeting NB 3318 does not prove it is the cheapest qualifying flight.
gaps: Select and verify the first flight in the cheapest-sorted nonstop results: the catalog has no positional targeting or result-order assertion, so targeting NB 3318 does not prove it is the cheapest qualifying flight.
